sections.heading: What is trending: “iphone 18”
paragraphs: “iphone 18” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for VN (snapshot taken 2026-08-26T05:51:18+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 500 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Báo Dân trí, Kenh14.vn, VnExpress. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “iPhone 18 Pro khác biệt thế nào so với 17 Pro” — VnExpress
“Apple sắp tăng giá iPhone?” — Báo Dân trí
“iPhone 18 Pro Max lộ mức giá khó tin” — Kenh14.vn

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Tue, 25 Aug 2026 22:10:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-08-26T05:51:18+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-08-26T05:51:27+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
